premises.text: Antibiotic overuse causes side effects and antimicrobial resistance, a top global health threat
premises.evidence_span: taking too many antibiotics can pose a danger to our health because of side effects as well as antimicrobial resistance

premises.text: Phages are natural precise agents that kill bad bacteria while leaving good bacteria alone
premises.evidence_span: they're natural and they're precise. They're like precise assassins that kill the bad bacteria, but leave the good bacteria alone

premises.text: Precision phage solutions require skin microbiome testing and large sequencing data because one phage serum only works for matching overgrowth cohorts
premises.evidence_span: if we were going to bring a precision serum or solution to market, we better have a test

premises.text: Four-swab discovery kit with room control plus whole genome sequencing (not 16S) profiles bacteria, viruses, fungi, and mites
premises.evidence_span: unlike others that use only one swab, we have four swabs in the kit

premises.text: Proprietary quantitative algorithm categorizes skin microbiome type and informs personalized recommendations and phage serum
premises.evidence_span: we use a proprietary unique algorithm to categorize your skin microbiome and we also use a spike to be quantitative

premises.text: Eight microbiome types map to eight phage serum formulations produced from large strain biobanks via high-throughput screening and bioreactors
premises.evidence_span: Parallel has defined eight different skin microbiome types and formulated eight different formulations

premises.text: Platform starts in skin (dermatologists are top antibiotic prescribers) and can scale to other human-health areas
premises.evidence_span: We're starting in skin. Why? Dermatologists are actually the number one prescribers of antibiotics across healthcare

value.text: Precision phage-based skin solutions matched to the patient's microbiome to reduce antibiotic dependence
value.evidence_span: get people off of Accutane and antibiotics

secondary_value.text: Broader human-health phage platform beyond skin
secondary_value.evidence_span: platform that is applicable to many areas of human health
